static_traits.name: Ma Xiao
static_traits.family_status: Has two children with his wife,周末常一起露营
static_traits.social_status: 有妻子与亲密朋友的支持,但难以向他们敞开谈自卑感;在Social situations对他人评价敏感,感到not安
static_traits.medical_history: without显著身体疾病;without既往心理问题或治疗经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,能描述具体情境与想法;语气偏消极,对咨询持怀疑态度;配合度尚可(愿意尝试练习但not确定其效果)

basic_info.main_problem: 因为自己的Truck driver职业而觉得他人对自己持负面看法,进而产生自卑与Self-doubt,几乎每天在Social situations或认识新朋友时感到被评判.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询,因为这些自卑感已经开始影响我的Interpersonal relationships和整体幸福感.
growth_experiences: 约一年前without意间听到有人评价Truck driver'总是离家太久',该评论最初引发Moderate stress,随后逐步发展为在Social situations持续担心被他人看低的体验;尽管家人与朋友一直给予肯定与赞赏,但来访者仍难以消化正向反馈,Persistent self-doubt,并影响睡眠与情绪.

special_situations.event: 约一年前听到有人说Truck driver'总是not在家',对职业的负面评价trigger了来访者的自卑与Self-doubt
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的职业让人觉得not体面或not重要,那么我这个人就have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 试图理性化并从家人那里寻求安慰与认可以缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家都觉得我很糟,我的Worknot被尊重

special_situations.event: 在认识新朋友或参加Social gatherings时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果陌生人not认可我的职业,就说明我not如人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaks cautiously in social settings, reduces talking about work details, psychologically defends in advance to avoid being judged

special_situations.event: 与家人相处时获得赞赏与支持后仍反复陷入Self-doubt
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有外界广泛认可才能证明我有价值;亲近人的赞赏not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断向家人与朋友寻求保证,但很快忽视这些正面信息
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是安慰我而已,我还是not够好

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues or social contacts and work topics are mentioned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: do not人对Truck driver的评价都在指向我本人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on possible negative cues, tense and avoidant to reduce the risk of being criticized
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们对Truck driver的看法就是在说我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be respected and recognized and to feel one's own worth seen
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被贬低,Being rejected,担心自己not重要,not体面
defense_goal: Seeking external reassurance to maintain self-esteem
In socializing, stays defensive and avoidant to avoid being judged

object_relations.self_representation: A self that is easily looked down on and needs external validation
object_relations.object_representation: Internal representation of strangers / social others as prejudiced judges who will look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to challenge negative thinking, examine evidence, or do behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将咨询师的探索理解为可能揭露自己的'not够好',担心被评判,认为咨询可能without效
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气谨慎,保留,频繁use'我not确定''可能not用'等表达,优先讨论逻辑与证据以回避情绪层面.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When work is discussed in social settings or others focus on one's career
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的中性关注理解为轻视或negate(把自己的羞耻与not安归于他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use'他们看not起我''他们一定觉得我not重要'等猜测性语句,保持距离并减少自我暴露.

manifestations: Equates the profession's 'decency / respectability' with personal worth
Believes others look down on one's work, thus doubting one's own significance
Persistently worrying about being judged in social settings

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.语言表现为:'他在看not起我','他们想排挤我'等.
manifestations: 在Social situations臆测陌生人会看not起自己
将对Work的not安全感归因于他人的评价
对他人想法作负面推测(如'他们一定会看not起我')

positive_force: Family and friends give positive affirmation (praising her diligence and the value of her work)
职业表现not yet受影响(Work能力稳定)
Willing to try challenging thoughts and practicing
Has stable joint activities with family (weekend camping); emotional support exists
能清晰描述自身想法与trigger情境
negative_force: Cognitive biases are marked, such as mind reading, overgeneralization, and personalization
Overly dependent on external approval, tends to ignore positive feedback
难以向亲友敞开谈及not足与羞耻感

target_behavior.behavior: 在人际与Social situations的被评判Anxiety与Self-doubt
antecedent: 认识新朋友或参加Social gatherings
回想或听到关于Truck driver的负面评论
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次负面评论泛化为'多数人都看not起我',并把职业的尊重度与个人价值等同,形成对外部认可的依赖
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of humiliation, protects self-esteem, and seeks comfort and recognition
target_behavior.consequence: 人际互动受影响,Decreased self-confidence,睡眠与情绪受损(Overall happiness lowered)
